where: Results > Morphometric analysis (Table 2 cited); Table 2, row 3 (voucher GXNU YU20160269), column ED
note: new trait key as main: eye_diameter_mm. Desk d583 filed other holotype eye measurements of this paper (UEW, TD, DNE; sensory_anatomy) but not ED; no eye_diameter_mm row for this species or DOI is on main. Table values and column mapping as returned by the page reader from the Pensoft article preview; the ED cell of row 8 matches the holotype text (4.3 mm), and the zobodat copy read for a cross-check gave the same ED column. Licence sentence on the copy read (opening): 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0),' with the usual continuation (the reader truncated the sentence at its quote limit). Byline as printed: Yuanqiang Pan, Mian Hou, Guohua Yu, Shuo Liu. Species validity: Amphibian Species of the World page opened from a search result, heading 'Zhangixalus yunnanensis Pan, Hou, Yu, and Liu, 2024', citation 'Zoosyst. Evol., 100: 188', holotype GXNU YU20160340; the page prints no explicit 'valid' (alternative combination Rhacophorus (Zhangixalus) yunnanensis by implication, Mahony et al. 2024).

eye: eye diameter (ED, diameter of exposed portion of eyeball); side not stated
method: linear measurement with electronic digital calipers; Materials and methods prints 'eye diameter (ED (eye diameter), diameter of exposed portion of eyeball)' and 'Morphometric data were taken using electronic digital calipers to the nearest 0.1 mm.' The Table 2 caption prints no unit; millimetres is established by the caliper sentence and by the holotype description, which prints 'snout (SL (snout length) 5.5 mm) longer than eye (ED (eye diameter) 4.3 mm)', matching the ED (4.3) and SL (5.5) cells of row 8 (GXNU YU20160340).
conditions: Female of Zhangixalus yunnanensis sp. nov. Measured specimen: specimen GXNU YU20160335 (Table 2 row 4). Table 2 caption: 'Measurements of Zhangixalus yunnanensis sp. nov. (1–9), Z. nigropunctatus (10–17) and Z. melanoleucus (18–21).' Table 2 columns: ID | Voucher no. | Sex | SVL | HL | HW | SL | IND | IOD | UEW | ED | TD | DNE | FHL | TL | TFL | FL (the quote is this specimen's row with cells joined by single spaces; the page reader expanded GXNU to 'Guangxi Normal University', not quoted). ED is the eighth number after Sex in the quote. Rows 10-21 belong to Z. nigropunctatus and Z. melanoleucus (comparison species), not filed. Holotype per the Amphibian Species of the World page: GXNU YU20160340. Table 2 first cited under Results > Morphometric analysis. Paratype status of the other rows was not read; they are the rows listed as the new species.
